readiness.hed: Scattered rain showers linger into tonight, a slight chance returns Friday morning, then colder and breezier air settles in for the weekend
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service has no active alerts for Fredericksburg. Today stays mostly cloudy near 66 with a 50 percent chance of scattered rain showers, continuing tonight with a 40 percent chance as the low drops to around 42. A slight chance of rain before 7 a.m. Friday gives way to partly sunny skies with a high near 53, but northwest wind gusts could reach 24 mph. Saturday turns mostly sunny but colder, with lows falling to around 31 both Friday night and Saturday night.
actions: Keep a rain layer handy today and tonight; expected totals stay under a tenth of an inch each round.
Friday morning commuters should plan for a brief slight-chance rain window before 7 a.m.
Secure light outdoor items Friday and Saturday as northwest gusts may reach 24 mph.
Protect sensitive plants and pipes Friday night and Saturday night as lows drop to around 31.
